fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6RXK2 (the inbox takes 30-40 s when a plan run is stopped at its gate; the Inbox app cannot scroll or act on that gate item). The planner read internal/api/inbox.go (inboxGateQuestions clears IndexPath and folds a model per question times per planned change set), question.go (gateAnswerCtx) and internal/tui/inboxapp (openGate/answerGate exist but are skipped when an item's Questions is empty, falling back to a non-scrollable detail panel). It raised four choices to the arbiter: the intent, the cheap read, the proof, and the app's action. The arbiter's Decision inbox-gate-questions-cheap settled them: serve milestone-26; read gate questions through the run worktree's own index with each planned change set folded at most once; always return one gate question per stop-detail handle even when the worktree's model can't be read; prove it with an internal/api budget test over the large generated log (no full-log decode, one fold per planned change set, within the read budget); in the Inbox app a gate item always opens the answer form, whose text scrolls, and every detail panel scrolls. No owner answered, so no owner words are quoted.
fields.title: Plan of the slow inbox at a gate, autonomous run with the arbiter
